mcp_sidecar_end_to_end.method: Real Modal sandbox of the fully exported task s3k_2076_legal_compliance_en_t5_rl_009 (real HF env-dir fetch, real Dockerfile build). After the ENTRYPOINT ran: all 15 MCP tool servers (clio_matter_operations .. servicenow_clerk_control_desk) started under the low-privilege mcpsvc user and listened on 39101-39115; /usr/local/bin/mcp (our stdlib CLI wrapper) called search_operational_matters on clio_matter_operations through the real MCP streamable-http protocol and got back a genuine application-level response ('provide at least one matter filter'), proving the tool code itself ran (not just a transport echo). An unknown-tool call correctly returned {'is_error': true, 'content': ['Unknown tool: ...']}.
bugs_found_and_fixed: The published general-agent-env-0 image ships `mcp` 2.2.0, whose `mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP` was renamed/restructured to `mcp.server.mcpserver.MCPServer`; the HF env dir's mcp_http.py (authored against mcp 1.x) crashed on import, so every per-tool subprocess the sidecar launched immediately zombied. Fixed by pinning `mcp<2` in the general Dockerfile (confirmed `mcp.client.streamable_http.streamable_http_client`, used by our CLI, exists under both 1.x and 2.x).

`pip install mcp` also installs mcp's OWN console-script at /usr/local/bin/mcp (needs `typer`, not pulled in by the pin); it was clobbering our wrapper when COPY'd before the pip install. Reordered the Dockerfile so our wrapper is copied AFTER the pip install.

Wrote our own minimal sidecar.py instead of vendoring MiMo's sidecar_entrypoint.py verbatim: that script hardcodes /opt/openai-agents-venv/bin/python, a venv path specific to MiMo's OWN training image that was not confirmed present in the published general-agent-env-0 image; ours uses the system python3 (mcp preinstalled there, confirmed by probing).

rule_item_grading.verified: offline only (tests/test_mimo_graders.py::GeneralGrader) -- gate semantics (gate item fails -> force_zero=True + judge skipped-equivalent via judge_request.force_zero; non-gate rule+llm atoms weighted-averaged with default weight 1.0) exercised against a synthetic verifier_meta.json, not the real s3k_2076 task's own check_code (which needs its own SQLite state.db fixtures under system/ -- not run against those in this session).
